name: OLED ClearType
tagline: Eliminate color fringing on WRGB and QD-OLED monitors with custom subpixel rendering.
problem: Windows ClearType assumes RGB stripe subpixels, causing severe color fringing on WRGB WOLED and RGB-triangular QD-OLED monitors. No OS-level fix exists despite years of community requests.
solution: A Windows utility that replaces ClearType's subpixel anti-aliasing with monitor-specific algorithms for WRGB stripe and RGB triangular layouts, delivering crisp, fringing-free text system-wide via a user-mode DirectWrite hook.
features: Automatic monitor subpixel layout detection via EDID parsing
Custom HLSL shader rendering engine for WRGB stripe (WOLED)
Custom HLSL shader rendering engine for RGB triangular (QD-OLED)
Per-monitor profiles with hot-swap on display connection change
System-wide injection via DirectWrite custom text renderer hook
ClearType-style tuner UI for contrast, gamma, and geometry per layout
Per-application exclude list (games, Electron apps, etc.)
Portable mode: no admin rights required for current-user session
Open-core shaders for community tuning and validation
mvp_scope: Build a user-mode DirectWrite hook that intercepts text rendering calls, detects connected OLED monitor subpixel layout via EDID, and applies a WRGB-stripe shader. Ship as a portable EXE with a system tray toggle and basic per-monitor on/off.
tech_stack: HLSL shaders compiled to DXBC via dxc
egui for native system tray and settings window
cargo-wix for MSI installer and portable zip packaging
EDID parsing via windows-rs DisplayConfig APIs

competitors.name: Windows ClearType
competitors.gap: Only supports RGB stripe geometry; no WRGB or triangular profiles

competitors.name: MacType
competitors.gap: GDIPP-based, unstable on Windows 11, no OLED-specific shaders

competitors.name: Better ClearType Tuner
competitors.gap: Only tweaks existing ClearType parameters; cannot change subpixel geometry

competitors.name: DisplayCAL
competitors.gap: Color calibration only; does not modify text rendering pipeline

competitors.name: NVIDIA/AMD Control Panels
competitors.gap: GPU-level scaling/sharpening; not subpixel-aware for text

landing_copy.headline: Crisp Text on Every OLED
landing_copy.subheadline: Finally, subpixel rendering that matches your monitor's actual layout — WRGB WOLED and RGB-triangular QD-OLED.
bullets: Auto-detects your panel's subpixel geometry via EDID
Custom shaders for WRGB stripe and RGB triangular layouts

whatsapp_bot.flow: User sends monitor model or EDID blob → bot replies with detected subpixel layout and direct download link for matching build → user runs portable EXE → bot follows up with license key after purchase.
